limitations: Pure shapes/brands are not runtime trust or authorization.
Data access must provide one coherent already-authorized snapshot.
Content equality cannot detect edit-away/back chronology.
UTC parsing is deliberately Z-only, valid year 0001-9999 with optional 1-6 fractional digits.
Nonblank boundary is stricter than SQL btrim; valid saved property input fingerprint bytes remain unchanged.
Registry eligibility, field rights, INITIAL_INPUT/history and ingestion timing require later trusted context.
Places/routing/map ports and guards are not complete adapters.
Browser pattern scans and offline tests do not establish real Auth/database/runtime security.
Ignored local logs are retained and hash-identified; portable manifest does not require them to be committed.
